items.text: Update 1.012 is now out on Steam, keepers.
Among the various bug fixes, QoL features and performance improvements, we’d like to highlight just a few that we think are pretty big and cool!

Previously, the PR Machine was a chore, and once your PR campaign started, there was nothing you could do to the machine itself. In this update, we decided to change how you run these campaigns and provide you with more flexibility.
First and foremost, you can now fully automate the process! No more tedious back-and-forth runs to reload it with the required items.

Now, all you need to do is just load the machine with the Hypno-devices and Newspapers in any quantity and run the campaigns for as long as needed (provided you have enough items for this period!). The machine will automatically use these items from the queue.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46076082/373c2bcbc1780a7215b7a9499016ca4b5c0eba79.gif"]

Also, you can now improve your PR Machine on any given day using just the Graveyard quality points. This is another reason for you to look after your graveyard – you are the Keeper and not just a propagandist after all!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46076082/7516b731109e5fa4c50b4b83cff9285283a8fa3e.gif"]
To balance it all out, you still need to load the items on the exact day. We just couldn’t simplify it THAT much, sorry.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46076082/d40554a6f7165d6d2e040c7ad12f615e6a4750ad.png"]

notes.title: More options to rest and pass time

items.text: In addition to sleep, you can now also sit on the bench by the campfire next to the Keeper’s house to restore energy and skip time. Cozy, innit?
Bear in mind that this does not save your progress or remove insanity and the ‘Lack of Sleep’ debuff. Once your energy is fully restored, you can keep sitting for as long as you like.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46076082/472ee0dc938d6814901dd3de17f991804fcc6c5e.gif"]

To make your life a little bit easier, and save you a few runs around the world, the Map now provides you with a lot more useful information at hand. For example, you can see how many bodies are stored in your morgue, the amount of current and max available zombies, or available order numbers.

[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46076082/918281b6c8d2700ab35f69e6b61e8d9071bf21f4.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46076082/bd281e4a2f6f18c024c2f855c3aed4aff8261bed.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46076082/25ca189ff042504bc7523ee92508137cfffff04a.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46076082/ea0fba75974731d7039ccba8ae37a7d7d393b0be.png"]
Memory usage optimization
Mercenaries now accept both wine and coin as payment, and can join the final battle even if unpaid.
PR Manager inspiration counts each day the machine was running.
Fixed zombies stopping work when the first craft in the queue has insufficient resources.
Fixed auto-crafting getting stuck when the queue is modified.
Fixed supply carriers not collecting from supply stations.
Fixed zombies stopped cooking on the stove.
Fixed random NPCs appearing in the Keeper’s home and walking through walls.
Fixed villagers and NPCs wandering into the void, through the church, or stuck inside houses.
Fixed a crash on the final sewer level.

Note: if you lost your items, use the Crown Nest near your home.
Fixed monks not giving the Monk’s sword after delivering the wine.
Fixed being unable to place a zombie for the “Personal Zombie Zone” quest.
Fixed NPCs pushing the player into corners and trapping them.
Fixed zombie supply stations that could not be removed at the Zombie Quarry.
Fixed incorrect visuals when picking up zombies (stacked zombies, or wood shown instead of a zombie).
Fixed building Crematorium II before Crematorium I consuming materials without spawning anything.
The tavern now sells more exhumation certificates at each level.
The Apothecary now sells beeswax.
Updated and fixed some tutorial texts.
Fixed Agatha not appearing for the ceremony after completing the choir in “The Nun Can Read”.
Fixed the first wood storage having the wrong size.
Fixed incorrect text order in the Forest guards dialogue.
Fixed getting stuck: between the sluice box and furnace, behind a teleporting pylon, at the water tub, behind the miner’s bench, and at the basement rubble.
Fixed falling out of bounds after destroying a vase in the alchemy tower.
Fixed a wood log dropped into geometry leaving the player stuck.
Fixed the missing capacity counter on the lower supply warehouse storage.
Fixed an extra empty slot in the house-repair / craft UI.
Fixed the furnace smoke and fire animation while smelting.
Fixed conveyor parts flickering near Jack.
Fixed vineyard row deformation on unsown beds.
Fixed the Keeper twitching after interacting with diggable objects.
Fixed the map right stick not working on the gamepad.
Fixed localization issues in Spanish, Portuguese, German, and French UI and tutorials.
This is not a drill, Keepers. WAKE UP!
Update 1.011 is here, and we have some exciting changes to share...starting with one of our highest-requested additions. Ready?
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46076082/e0195567a2c7d7892148a337367b63a102e9bf5f.gif"]

Your eyes do not decieve you. You asked, and we listened - you can now move placed objects in build mode. No more destroying and rebuilding - change your Workyard around and spend more time profiting from those around you!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46076082/02c80b87e5da7e0311baf8f1a6b4c6bdfac27f09.gif"]

Access your Mods with a few clicks with the brand new in-game mod menu - enable or disable them in a click, or check out their latest updates on the Workshop. BepInEx now ships with the game, too, so they'll be added automatically when you download them.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46076082/e3a31aa279072f9cc2ccc93403a30a7d213ed42c.gif"]

Need some good old-fashioned home cooking? Some Bricks? More Peat? Your Zombies can now handle them all - as long as you have the resources, your Zombies will continue making them! They may be brain-dead, but at least they're useful!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46076082/21766c2c2ac4ca225bee9667e1fb997e9db7a500.gif"]
Read the full changelog below for everything else that's included in the latest update, or simply update your game to try them out for yourself!
Please note that this update could impact any existing mods - we recommend you check the mod you're using for compatability before enabling it!
Graveyard Keeper 2 — Changelog 1.011 (Steam)

notes.title: Zombie-assistants now can start and finish autocrafts

items.text: in the Yard: Furnaces and Kiln
in the Home: Kitchen Oven
in the Garden: Compost Pile
in the Vineyard Basement: for Cider and Wine production
in the Alchemy Lab: Distillation Cube
They get tech-points when finish the craft but they still need mastery for starting the crafts.
Zombie-workers in a Quarry now bring Stone and Marble to the chests by themselves (like sand/clay diggers, lumberjacks and miners) - you don't need Zombie-assistant in a Quarry anymore!
Zombies can now be cremated.

items.text: Graveyard Keeper 2 — Changelog 1.010
Quests & progression
Fixed being unable to place the banner in Central Districts Purge: Part II.
Fixed Jack missing when submitting the bronze tools.
Fixed NPC Jack missing from the Twins' land near the boat during the Village Boat event.
Fixed the glitched door to the Doctor's basement.
Fixed some inspirations requiring more actions than the world allows.
Fixed issues with town-related inspirations.
Fixed issues with the Dry Cleaning and Surgeon's Error inspirations.
Fixed NPCs all showing "..." above their heads.
Softlocks & getting stuck
Fixed the Keeper getting stuck behind or in the bed after loading a save.
Fixed getting stuck in the dungeon after entering from the Town Warehouse.
Fixed the Keeper sinking into the ground after leaving the Town Warehouse upper floor.
Fixed getting stuck behind pottery during the sewer fight.
Fixed being trapped after soldiers spawn.
Fixed being trapped after building a crypt.
Fixed getting stuck between the church fence and a grave.
Fixed falling through the world when teleporting to the Floating Village.
Fixed getting stuck at the barricaded passages at the morgue and the underground well.
Fixed getting stuck behind bushes near Jack's Bridge and in the fruit garden.
Fixed the character walking through a wall when entering with Gunther.
Fixed getting stuck in spots that look passable.
Fixed being boxed in by pulled-in or floor items and unable to move.
Zombies & workers
Zombies now give more gears with Belt Master perk.
Fixed the zombie porter walking through factory walls.
Gameplay
Order slots count now rise up to 5 depending on villagers count.
Fixed wood disappearing from the player's hands.
Fixed being able to plant onion seeds in vineyard plots.
Fixed the morgue counter staying at 1/19 with no corpses present.
Fixed items not being picked up after inventory space was freed.
Fixed overhead items not hiding while using the pre-order sauna.
Stability
Fixed a consistent crash during Battle Operation Potato Part I.
Fixed the game hanging on exit after long play sessions.
UI & visuals
Fixed controller issues in gameplay and in the garden bed UI.
Fixed Builder's Bag items becoming inaccessible with a controller.
Fixed the bug report button not being localized.
Fixed tutorial windows not resizing to fit their text.
Fixed the Keeper's arms staying raised.
Fixed conveyor zone extension animations.
Fixed an NPC clipping into a table at the port tavern.
Fixed a crash that could happen while loading a save.
Fixed error pop-ups when a gardener zombie tried to harvest a crop that was already gone.
Fixed a freeze when assigning a zombie to a station if the previous worker was no longer valid.
Fixed the player or the HUD staying locked after returning to the main menu or starting a new game, including a cinematic or a fight that never cleared.
Fixed the day not rolling over when the clock landed exactly on the end of the day. This showed up as a day jump in the quests UI after a sermon.

Cleaned up collisions on conveyor storage, the crematorium, the resurrection table, and the garden and vineyard assistant stations. The box carried overhead no longer blocks movement.
Fixed the interaction point on the locked tower gate.
Fixed items from the sawhorse dropping in the wrong place.
You can pick up or inspect a caretaker from their station while they are out working.
Fixed caretakers getting stuck on quarry objects.
Fixed zombies at the sawmill, mine, clay pit, and sand pit getting stuck after carrying the result back, so the next job can start.

Fixed gardener zombies getting stuck on a broken harvest. They return to the station, and a harvest that keeps failing is left for you. Garden and vineyard workers no longer keep a hat on while they are at the station.
Bait stored in bags is now found when you fish.
Fixed gamepad navigation skipping inventories in the storage window when a bag is open.
Fixed the Son of a Butcher perk so its bonus applies to organ surgery and pocket extraction.

The tier-2 kitchen oven no longer appears in the tech tree when the kitchen table is unlocked. It stays hidden until the oven is repaired. Existing saves are corrected.
Fixed the study table starting the wrong survey for grape juice and grape wine.
Craft tooltips no longer list a station extension that is already attached.
Fixed crows getting stuck in a looking animation.
Fixed the woodpecker not returning to its perch after flying, and a broken peck animation.
Fixed misplaced icons in the garden bed window.
Fixed missing Chinese icons on the HUD.
Updated the credits.
Fixed the sermon ending incorrectly.

Changelog 1.008
Crashes & error pop-ups
General
Fixed a crash when going to bed that could throw the player out of bounds.
Fixed loading a save getting stuck on an infinite load screen (conveyor-related exception).
Fixed persistent error / exception messages that could keep popping up.
Softlocks & collisions
Cleaned up a weird collision on the right side of the workyard.
Fixed clipping / stuck issues in the Town Warehouse and vine cellar.
Combat & exploits
Fast Travel Points can no longer be used during battle.
Fixed the zombie Panic debuff not triggering when over the zombie cap.
Placeholder text fight_start_overhead_reason no longer appears after initiating combat.
Zombies, farming & stations
Fixed a zombie getting stuck trying to take items from the firewood holder.
Fixed wheat visually following the player and farmers failing to produce.
Fixed conflicting interaction hints when carrying a zombie near the carousel.
Inventory & items
Fixed items (including compost and similar) incorrectly “teleporting” into the inventory from a distance when space becomes available.
Crafting, perks & progression systems
Fixed the Sommelier perk so it correctly boosts wine crafting.
Corrected incorrect requirement info in the distiller craft tooltip.
Fixed the PR machine lasting less time than stated (progress bar and duration).
Graphics & UI
Clay storage no longer looks empty when more than half full.
Fixed a townsman trimming an invisible bush after reclaiming the town.
Fixed strange item spacing in the Alchemy folio.
Tutorial window text lines are no longer placed too close vertically.
Fixed the study table window not resizing for long item names.
Fixed the Close (X) button on the study-complete window.
Save slots now show up-to-date info and the correct happiness icon (instead of outdated villager data).
Quests & progression
Fixed the Inflation / mercenary quest error that blocked progress and left a garden plot locked.
Fixed main questline soft-lock when completing Linda’s Ball before the Plague Doctor’s Beautiful Dream (basement access / plague-doctor progression).
Balance
Increased the number of likes earned from deliveries (Orders)
Reduced delivery requirements (fewer crates)
Increased the bonus from the "Happy Supplier" perk
Increased the maximum number of likes that can be earned from trading with vendors
Increased the number of likes that can be earned from trading a specific item with vendors
Increased the amount of "Town Gratitude" earned for winning battles
Dear Graveyard Keepers,
We’ve received a huge number of your reports, suggestions, and requests for improvements to the game. Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback with us.
We’re working hard to address the issues you’ve reported and to improve the overall experience. Your feedback helps us understand what needs the most attention and where we can make the game better.
Changelog — 1.007
Crashes
Fixed repeated exception / error pop-ups that could break the session.
Fixed a crash when a zombie caretaker tried to pick items up from inventory.
General
Your zombies now earn red tech points for winning fights
Fixed getting stuck on the pier stairs.
Fixed getting stuck on a hatch when a workbench was placed on it.
Fixed getting wedged between workstations, chests, and extensions when pushed by a moving zombie.
Cleaned up collision issues in the first part of Town.
Exploits, inventory & items
Fixed item-duplication exploits (including bag-to-bag transfers and alchemy / farmer bag abuse).
Dynamite can now be destroyed or sold.
Crafting & workstations
Fixed the study table not awarding science points and some items being unstudiable.
Fixed the potter’s wheel getting stuck on Craft (and unable to be destroyed).
Fixed being unable to obtain polished stone.
Fixed the Tempering Expert perk so it correctly grants its Mastery bonus and unlocks Master Armor / sword crafting.
Farming
Fixed being unable to harvest the bush near the factory entrance.
Fixed the player’s head disappearing while planting.
Graphics & UI
Clay storage no longer looks empty when more than half full.
Fixed mixed-up draw layers on the conveyor supplier station.
Removed unnecessary +/− buttons for Repair Kit quantity when repairing the Vineyard Bridge.
Fixed placeholder text showing instead of the character name “Jully”.
Performance
Fixed severe FPS drops (down to ~2 FPS) when saving.
Quests, progression & balance
Fixed a translation error that blocked quest completion.
Restored the missing description for the “Inflation” quest.
Fixed the game-breaking Central Districts Purge: Part I & Central Districts Purge: Part II progression issue.
Fixed the PR machine not working.
Fixed iron supply delivery quests getting stuck.
Jack now correctly receives the tools he asks for (instead of details).
Rebalanced self-study books.
Changelog — 1.006
New features
Added in-game bug report functionality for the Steam PC build.
Zombies, stations & cooking
Zombies should now earn red tech-points in fights.
Zombie work sounds now play correctly when work starts while you’re off-scene.
Fixed zombie placement at the cooking oven blocking the millstone.
Kitchen zombies no longer consume or burn ingredients without producing the dish.
Fixed getting stuck between kitchen chest and firewood.
Fixed getting wedged between workstations / chests / extensions when pushed by a zombie.
Inventory, trading & economy
Extra bag slots now work for pickups and vendor buys when the backpack is full.
Static-price trade goods keep a fixed price (no doubling on first buy).
UI, graphics & cinematics
Changing resolution no longer breaks grass sway / deformation.
Restored missing cinematic VFX (smoke / fog) in shipping builds.
Audio
Flagpole plant / remove sounds no longer play incorrectly at fight start / end.
Progression & achievements
Demo-save milestones unlock Steam achievements retroactively in the full game.
Players can no longer destroy Defender’s Emblems and soft-lock zombie squad unlocks.
Other
Fixed intermittent crashes on ultrawide / non-standard resolutions.
Fixed crop beds getting permanently stuck just before harvest (couldn’t inspect, harvest, or remove the bed).
Changelog — 1.005
Stations & morgue
Fixed the Study Table locking up after inserting an item for Science, so research could no longer be started.
Fixed the Crematorium getting stuck with a corpse on the table and becoming unusable.
Fixed “prepared” body / strap state on the Resurrection Table resetting after leaving and re-entering the morgue.
Fixed resurrected zombies showing the wrong (pre-resurrection) animation when re-entering the morgue.
Fixed cases where zombies could not be resurrected even when quest and item requirements were met.
Added the missing zombie-limit hint at the Resurrection Table on PlayStation.
Building & zones
You can demolish buildings in the resurrection zone again.
UI & HUD
Quest navigation hints now hide properly during sleep / blackout.
Fixed the alchemy recipe book selection highlight overlapping a UI separator.
Fixed Inquisition Base UI flickering when repeatedly interacting with locked objects.
Combat & movement
Fixed the player floating over stairs during combat.
Balance
Increased tree-log yield when sawing (more chunks per log).
Rebalanced Kiln and Furnace craft / fuel costs.
Performance & stability
Improved performance at the top of the alchemy tower (heavy FPS drops).
Cleared a batch of errors that showed up before the first sleep / save.
Audio & visuals
Fixed the Keeper’s house oven playing the “job done” sound every time you enter, even when idle.
Fixed incorrect wheat bending animation when walking through crops (Switch).
Zombie crafts
Pending zombie crafts now show when skill level is too low, and craft-lock / wait-delivery icons behave correctly.
We just released a quick hotfix.
Fixed an issue that, in some cases, prevented the pre-order content from appearing in existing save files.
